subject: English
stimulus: a. Why should we learn a common language? b. Where can we learn communicative English? c. What things can help us learn English? d. What are we learning English at the moment for? e. How are vast distances shortened? Extra Practices f. How is it possible to talk to a person thousands of kilometers away? g. How long do we spend to learn English? h. What will we see during our classroom activities? i. What has made the communicative easier? j. What opportunity can you get by learning English?
guide_solution: a. We should learn a common language as it is impossible for us to speak all the languages of the world. b. We can learn communicative English both in and outside the classroom. c. The text-book, the radio, television, newspapers, computers, magazines and other supplementary materials can greatly help us learn English. d. We are learning English at the moment mainly for our exams. e. Vast distances are shortened by speedy transport. f. It is possible to talk to a person thousands of kilometers away on the phoe or the Internet. g. We spend for 12 or 14 years to learn English. h. We will see how we can learn English during our classroom activities. i. English has made the communication easier. j. By learning English we can get the opportunity to find a good job both inside and outside the country.
